description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes an array of cost data records, organizing and aggregating them for visualization purposes, specifically suited for creating stacked series charts with zero-filled stacks.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a dataset suitable for stacked charts, categorizing and summing costs by specified grouping ('environment' or 'cost_category'), with options for labeling and sorting.
